name: inventory_ledger_integrity
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0023') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname IN ('ck_inventory_movements__movement_type','ck_inventory_movement_lines__quantity_nonzero')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('bt_inventory_movements__posting_context','bt_inventory_movement_lines__direction','ct_inventory_movements__has_lines_at_commit','bt_inventory_movements__immutable','bt_inventory_movement_lines__immutable') AND NOT tgisinternal) AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname IN ('ck_inventory_movements__movement_type','ck_inventory_movement_lines__quantity_nonzero')) = 2 AND (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('bt_inventory_movements__posting_context','bt_inventory_movement_lines__direction','ct_inventory_movements__has_lines_at_commit','bt_inventory_movements__immutable','bt_inventory_movement_lines__immutable') AND NOT tgisinternal) = 5 AND (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('fn_inventory_movement_posting_context_valid','fn_inventory_movement_line_direction_valid','fn_inventory_movement_has_lines_at_commit','fn_inventory_ledger_row_immutable')) = 4 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the Inventory Ledger integrity migration back. After a successful apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve immutable Inventory history and issue a reviewed corrective migration rather than dropping integrity/immutability protection or rewriting posted movements.
